title: Ngamo language
text: Ngamo (also known as Ngamawa, Gamo, Gamawa) is an Afro-Asiatic language spoken in Nigeria. The native Ngamo language has two major dialects, viz, Gudi Ngamo and Yaya Ngamo. These dialects are spoken by the various clans both within and outside Gadaka.

title: Ngamo language — Grokipedia
text: Ngamo is a Chadic language within the Afro-Asiatic phylum, belonging to the West Chadic branch. It is specifically classified in the Bole subgroup of West Chadic A, alongside closely related languages such as Bole, Karekare, and Maka.
